params.value: 74B total / 9B active (card); HF GGUF metadata total 74,042,720,848. Compressed from Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B-A12B (Star Elastic), top-k 9. GGUF header arithmetic: routed experts 15.88 GiB of 20.50 GiB tensors; only 0.407 GiB routed bytes read per token vs 4.09 GiB dense (Mamba NVFP4, Q8_0 attention/latent/output, shared experts).

architecture.value: Nemotron-H hybrid Mamba-2 + Transformer LatentMoE + C-RADIO v4-H vision. config.json: NemotronH_Omni_Reasoning_V3 / llm NemotronHPuzzleForCausalLM; 88 blocks = 40 Mamba-2 + 40 MoE + 8 full attention (indices 7,16,25,36,47,58,69,78), hidden 4096, 32 q heads, 2 KV heads, head_dim 128, no sliding window; Mamba 128x64, state 128; MoE heterogeneous 240-496 routed experts per layer, width 1536-2560, 9 active, 1 shared (5376), latent 1024, relu2, sigmoid routing; vocab 131072. Quant: experts IQ2_XXS QAT (2.0625 bpw), Mamba NVFP4 W4A16, rest Q8_0. GGUF arch nemotron_h_moe.

context_length.value: 262144 (max_position_embeddings and GGUF context_length 262144; card 'Up to 256K'); long-context recovery trained at 128K; NVIDIA 28GB recipe uses 65,536 q8_0 KV; Unsloth says up to 128K.

modalities.value: Input text, image, video; output text. Vision is a separate mmproj GGUF (1.61 GiB), so omitting --mmproj / passing --no-mmproj gives a text-only path in llama.cpp. Safetensors shards include vision_model and mlp1.

thinking.how_to_toggle: Template default enable_thinking=True. Off: chat_template_kwargs {"enable_thinking": false}; medium: {"enable_thinking": true, "medium_effort": true}. llama.cpp b12407: per request chat_template_kwargs, server default --chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking":false}' or --reasoning off, reasoning in reasoning_content. vLLM: same kwargs, --default-chat-template-kwargs; card uses plugin parser ultra_v3 (repo file; in-tree has nemotron_v3). Ollama: thinking capability, parser nemotron-3-nano, native 'think' true/false (/v1 toggle unverified). History reasoning re-inserted only from reasoning_content and truncated before last user turn.

tool_calling.format: Qwen3-Coder XML: <tool_call><function=NAME><parameter=ARG>VALUE</parameter></function></tool_call>; tools in <tools>; results in <tool_response> inside a user turn
tool_calling.evidence: chat_template.jinja (identical to GGUF tokenizer.chat_template) has the tool block; card has a llama.cpp tool-calling example; vLLM recipe uses --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder; llama.cpp b12407 common/chat.cpp:1420-1427 routes this template to the Qwen3-Coder handler. Community self-run on the 24GB file: BFCL simple 94.3% correct, multiple 92.0%.

vllm.arch_supported: Yes at v0.33.0: registry.py line 553 NemotronH_Omni_Reasoning_V3 -> nano_nemotron_vl; line 187 NemotronHPuzzleForCausalLM -> nemotron_h. Card minimum nightly 77154ca (2026-10-14) is contained in v0.33.0 (843 commits ahead).
vllm.kv_math: Budget 14.65 GiB - 22.43 GiB weights (incl. vision; ~20.8 without) - 1.2 reserve = -8.98 GiB: no KV pool. KV/token 2 x 8 attn x 2 KV heads x 128 x 2 B = 8192 B BF16, 4096 B FP8; Mamba state ~84 MB/seq bf16. Expert CPU offload not usable (#66264).
vllm.quant_on_sm120: MIXED_PRECISION ggml-packed IQ2_XXS/Q8_0 runs only via b12x kernels (docs/features/quantization/b12x.md: pip vllm[b12x], --linear-backend b12x --moe-backend b12x, SM120/121); b12x not in vllm/vllm-openai:v0.33.0.
vllm.reasoning_parser: ultra_v3 plugin (ultra_v3_reasoning_parser.py); in-tree nemotron_v3 untested for this model
vllm.min_version: nightly-77154ca per card (v0.33.0 newer) plus pip b12x and vllm download-kernels
vllm.serve_command: Not runnable on 16 GB. Card: VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 vllm serve nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-74B-A9B-24GB --trust-remote-code --max-model-len 262144 --max-num-seqs 1 --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --linear-backend b12x --moe-backend b12x --attention-backend FLASHINFER --mamba-backend flashinfer --mamba-cache-mode align --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder --reasoning-parser-plugin ultra_v3_reasoning_parser.py --reasoning-parser ultra_v3
vllm.known_issues: Needs b12x and 24 GB+ GPU (card: A100/H100-80GB/Blackwell). FP8 KV via FlashInfer on sm_120 (#61239).

llamacpp.arch_supported: Yes. llama-arch.cpp at b12407: nemotron_h_moe (line 105), ffn_latent_down/up (584-585); nemotron-h.cpp loads per-layer expert counts/widths (111-131). Added by PR #30520 merged 2026-10-15; first build b11669. CUDA NVFP4 kernels present. Pixtral pre-tokenizer bug #30894 fixed by PR #30960 (2026-10-22), included in b12407. draft-dflash and draft-lilicorr spec types exist.
llamacpp.quant: IQ2_XXS QAT experts, NVFP4 Mamba, Q8_0 rest
llamacpp.offload_plan: Non-routed 4.617 GiB on GPU; routed experts 15.882 GiB. KV f16 8192 B/token (128k 1.00 GiB; 256k q8_0 1.06 GiB); Mamba state 0.16 GiB; compute ~1.0 GiB. Fixed GPU at 128k f16 = 6.78 GiB, leaving ~8.0 GiB for experts of a ~14.8 GiB target. --n-cpu-moe 50: 8.23 GiB experts in RAM, 7.65 GiB on GPU, total ~14.4 GiB. Same N gives 256k with q8_0 KV; 64k f16 needs N=46. Drafter would add 0.93 GiB GPU (~2 more blocks to RAM), benefit unmeasured.
llamacpp.server_command: docker run --rm --name bolt --device nvidia.com/gpu=all -e GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1 --memory 24g -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -v $HOME/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp:server-cuda-b12407 --hf-repo nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-74B-A9B-24GB-GGUF --hf-file NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-74B-A9B-24GB.gguf --no-mmproj --alias nemotron-bolt -c 131072 -np 1 -ngl 999 --n-cpu-moe 50 -fa on -b 2048 -ub 512 --jinja --temp 1.0 --top-p 0.95 --chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking":false}' --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
llamacpp.tool_calling_note: Qwen3-Coder XML handler (common/chat.cpp:1420-1427); reasoning in reasoning_content. Same handler family as #30118, so smoke-test tool calls. Thinking ON by default in template.

speed_notes: Inferred at --n-cpu-moe 50: GPU reads 4.27 GiB/token (4.59 GB) -> 5.1 ms at 896 GB/s; RAM reads 0.22 GiB (0.235 GB) -> 2.9 ms at 80 GB/s; ceiling ~125 tok/s, realistic ~55-80 tok/s using the ~69% efficiency implied by the community DGX Spark 40.1 tok/s. Dense part dominates, so offload costs little. NVIDIA's own RTX Spark data shows Bolt slower than Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (84 vs 97 TPS; 601 s vs 454 s agent replay). Prefill with CPU experts unmeasured (#25859).

opencode_fit.recommended_runtime: llama.cpp server-cuda-b12407 (Ollama fallback slower; vLLM does not fit)
opencode_fit.recommended_context: 131072 f16 KV with --n-cpu-moe 50 (256k with q8_0 KV at same N)
opencode_fit.caveats: NVIDIA's 32 GB+ guidance assumes all-GPU plus drafter and mmproj; here ~8 GiB experts go to RAM. All numbers are estimates, nothing measured. Quality is NVIDIA-reported only, no SWE-bench Verified, no independent score. Thinking defaults ON; agent replay 32% slower than Qwen3.6 per NVIDIA. Tool calls via Qwen3-Coder XML handler (#30118 risk). OpenCode reasoningField reasoning_content. Worth a measured head-to-head with pick #1.
